Supporting_Evidence: First post-invasion in-person return; bilateral; allied protest; Trump rationale; Russian financial-cooperation framing
Counterevidence_or_Alternative: Bessent imposed a reported condition; Russia remained a member; dialogue can be useful
Recommended_Wording: Front-loaded normalization and allied-fracture value
Missing_Record: A proven quid pro quo or immediate sanctions relief
FOIA_or_Record_Target: Asheville was a verified discretionary normalization event whose immediate Russian benefit preceded any publicly announced concession.
column13: What concession, if any, was privately obtained or later performed?
column14: Invitation rationale, complete bilateral record, Russian response and implementation files

Exact_Claim: Witkoff publicly framed his Putin encounters as future retirement memories near the top of his experience
Source_Class: Kremlin-released video; Reuters and Washington Post documentary reporting
Supporting_Evidence: The opening wording and named participants are publicly documented
Counterevidence_or_Alternative: The remark may have been deliberate rapport-building rather than an expression of policy preference
Recommended_Wording: Witkoff used unusually personal and self-referential language toward Putin at the opening of the talks
Missing_Record: Full official video, transcript, prepared remarks, and delegation briefing
FOIA_or_Record_Target: White House, State, NSC, Presidential records, Kremlin public archive

Exact_Claim: American diplomats have previously used warm and flattering language toward Soviet and Russian leaders
Source_Class: FRUS and State Department primary records
Supporting_Evidence: Davies, Truman, Kissinger, Shultz, and Kerry provide documented precedents
Counterevidence_or_Alternative: Contexts varied substantially and several examples followed or accompanied concrete reciprocal diplomacy
Recommended_Wording: Warmth is not literally unprecedented in U.S.–Soviet or U.S.–Russian diplomacy
Missing_Record: Broader corpus review of public and private diplomatic transcripts
FOIA_or_Record_Target: State Department Office of the Historian; presidential libraries; NARA

Exact_Claim: No close modern public analogue was located for the complete configuration of Witkoff's statement
Supporting_Evidence: Review covered major official records involving Stalin, Brezhnev, Gorbachev, and Putin
Counterevidence_or_Alternative: The review is not an exhaustive search of every classified, private, or untranslated exchange
Recommended_Wording: The formulation appears rare because it combined a subordinate envoy, an unresolved war, no announced concession, and a self-referential lifetime-memory tribute
Missing_Record: Complete searchable corpus of diplomatic memoranda and audiovisual records
FOIA_or_Record_Target: NARA; State; presidential libraries; foreign archives

Exact_Claim: The public tribute supplied relationship and status value to Putin independent of a completed settlement
Supporting_Evidence: Kremlin publication, Putin trust framing, no announced breakthrough, unchanged demands
Counterevidence_or_Alternative: Flattery may preserve access and could be intended to facilitate future concessions
Recommended_Wording: The remark is evidence of a relationship-centered negotiating posture; its actual bargaining effect and motive remain unresolved
Missing_Record: Internal strategy, talking points, Russian assessment, and later concessions
FOIA_or_Record_Target: White House, State, NSC, intelligence and Russian records

Exact_Claim: Eric Johnston used a closely parallel memory formulation toward Stalin in 1944
Supporting_Evidence: U.S. Embassy reporting reproduced Johnston's letter published by Izvestiya
Counterevidence_or_Alternative: The USSR was a wartime ally against Nazi Germany; Johnston's mission concerned trade and credits; he was not negotiating an ongoing Soviet war against a U.S.-supported state
Recommended_Wording: Johnston is the closest verbal precedent located and prevents describing Witkoff's wording as literally unprecedented
Missing_Record: Johnston's full mission instructions, Roosevelt correspondence, and original English letter
FOIA_or_Record_Target: State Department, FDR Library, U.S. Chamber archives

Exact_Claim: George W. Bush publicly personalized trust in Putin at their first 2001 summit
Supporting_Evidence: Bush called Putin trustworthy, said he could sense his soul, and described him as a remarkable leader
Counterevidence_or_Alternative: Bush was president, not an envoy; the meeting preceded Russia's later wars of territorial expansion; it was not a lifetime-memory tribute
Recommended_Wording: Bush provides the closest modern Putin-specific precedent for highly personalized public trust but not the complete Witkoff configuration
Missing_Record: Internal summit assessments and later retrospective evaluations
FOIA_or_Record_Target: George W. Bush Presidential Library, State, NSC records

Exact_Claim: Lukoil announced a nonexclusive Carlyle agreement subject to approvals and excluding Kazakhstan assets
Counterevidence_or_Alternative: Executed SPA and sale completion not obtained
Recommended_Wording: Lukoil announced a conditional agreement; no price or closing is established
Missing_Record: Executed SPA; asset schedule; regulatory decisions; closing record
FOIA_or_Record_Target: Lukoil; Carlyle; OFAC

Exact_Claim: Preliminary accounts state that the Carlyle SPA lapsed at end-July without OFAC approval
Counterevidence_or_Alternative: Accounts not finalized or shareholder-approved; underlying SPA and OFAC record not inspected
Recommended_Wording: The filing reports lapse for lack of approval; formal rejection and exact expiry day are not established
Missing_Record: Executed SPA; extension or termination notices; OFAC application disposition
FOIA_or_Record_Target: Lukoil; Carlyle; OFAC

Exact_Claim: Preliminary accounts disclose March 31 permission for a 75% West Qurna-2 transfer under a February 23 contract
Counterevidence_or_Alternative: Underlying license, consideration and settlement records not obtained
Recommended_Wording: LIG disclosed permission for the separate Iraqi transfer; it did not establish closing or permission for the full portfolio sale
Missing_Record: Specific license; executed contract; title and settlement evidence
FOIA_or_Record_Target: OFAC; LUKOIL Mid-East Limited; Basra Oil Company

Exact_Claim: GL 131J requires separate authorization for sale performance; FAQ 1224 states expected proceeds safeguards
Counterevidence_or_Alternative: General permission and expected criteria do not identify a final buyer or approved consideration
Recommended_Wording: Negotiation authority and announced review conditions do not establish an approved or completed sale
Missing_Record: Specific licenses; buyer and payment terms; closing evidence
FOIA_or_Record_Target: Treasury/OFAC; transaction parties

Exact_Claim: DFC announced an IHC cooperation framework including energy infrastructure without naming Lukoil allocation
Evidence_Status: Established announcement; project allocation not established
Counterevidence_or_Alternative: General framework is not a project-specific financing commitment
Recommended_Wording: DFC announced an IHC framework; the release does not establish Lukoil financing or approval
Missing_Record: Executed framework; project-specific approval and financing instruments
FOIA_or_Record_Target: DFC; IHC

Exact_Claim: Atash disclosed a conditional April 2024 option for MOL RBS Operator over 57.8 percentage points of its 87.8% Trident interest
Source_Class: Filed company statement; MOL issuer reporting
Evidence_Status: Established as company disclosure; exercise unverified
Counterevidence_or_Alternative: Option contract and governmental decision not obtained; option price and expiry not disclosed
Recommended_Wording: Atash reported an option and approval application; no exercise or completed transfer is established
Missing_Record: Executed farm-out; approval decision; option consideration; exercise and closing evidence
FOIA_or_Record_Target: Atash; MOL RBS Operator; Romanian authorities

Exact_Claim: Atash disclosed PPL-003-2019 with LIG-E003 and US$725.461 million principal under a US$750 million facility at year-end 2024
Evidence_Status: Established as company-reported financing and accounting classification
Counterevidence_or_Alternative: Equity-classified under company policy; facility ceiling is not an additional draw; disposal treatment unknown
Recommended_Wording: The named parent financing is equity-classified and is not established as buyer funding or disposal proceeds
Missing_Record: Loan agreement; creditor-side balance; assignment conversion repayment or escrow records
FOIA_or_Record_Target: Atash; LUKOIL International Upstream Holding B.V.

Exact_Claim: Atash disclosed separate US$381 million ultimate-parent facilities with US$76.592 million utilized and US$103.852 million noncurrent carrying value
Evidence_Status: Established as reported historical loan balances
Counterevidence_or_Alternative: Amounts are different measures of related obligations; complete carrying-balance reconciliation not supplied
Recommended_Wording: Separate ultimate-parent loans mature December 31 2029 at SOFR plus 4%; limits draws and carrying amounts are not additive
Missing_Record: Executed loan schedules; accrued-interest reconciliation; creditor and settlement records
FOIA_or_Record_Target: Atash; ultimate parent of LUKOIL Group

Exact_Claim: Carso reported Zamajal signed a January 19 agreement with the existing E003 and E006 sellers for all Fieldwood Mexico B.V. shares
Evidence_Status: Established as company-disclosed binding agreement; closing unverified
Counterevidence_or_Alternative: Conditions and approvals remained in the disclosure; underlying executed agreement not inspected
Recommended_Wording: The agreement identifies buyer sellers and target; corporate and project stakes do not establish transfer completion
Missing_Record: Executed agreement; governmental and corporate approvals; title and closing records
FOIA_or_Record_Target: Zamajal; LIG-E003; LIG-E006; Fieldwood Mexico

Exact_Claim: Carso separately disclosed US$270 million purchase price and assumption of US$330 million company debt owed to Lukoil
Source_Class: Primary issuer results; indexed primary annual report
Evidence_Status: Established disclosed terms; approval and settlement unverified
Counterevidence_or_Alternative: Closing adjustments apply; complete annual original and specific OFAC decision not obtained; no paid amounts established
Recommended_Wording: Share consideration and assumed company debt are separate conditional components; express OFAC authorization is an issuer-stated condition
Missing_Record: Specific approvals; adjusted consideration; debt allocation; financing and settlement waterfall
FOIA_or_Record_Target: Carso; Zamajal; sellers; Treasury/OFAC; Mexican authorities

Exact_Claim: ALT5 reports a January 29 full $15 million loan draw and approximately $14.2 million net proceeds; June 27 debt balance remains $15 million
Source_Class: Issuer SEC filings and filed dated loan exhibit
Evidence_Status: Established issuer disclosure; settlement not independently reconciled
Counterevidence_or_Alternative: Gross, net and later balance are one financing; actual USD/USD1 mix unknown
Recommended_Wording: The issuer reported the draw and net proceeds; the later balance is not another receipt
Missing_Record: Closing statement; bank and wallet settlement records
FOIA_or_Record_Target: Public filing follow-up; borrower and lender records if lawfully available

Exact_Claim: The dated January loan exhibit specifies 4.50% prepaid annual interest, a 24-month term, collateral-only recourse and a final-look provision for WLFI-secured financing
Source_Class: Filed loan exhibit and issuer summary
Evidence_Status: Documented terms; blank signature fields in filed counterpart
Supporting_Evidence: ALT5-S010 sections 2–3 and 21; Schedule 1; ALT5-S009 Item 1.01
Counterevidence_or_Alternative: No independently authenticated signed counterpart; arm's-length and market-check statements are parties' representations
Recommended_Wording: The filed dated agreement sets out the financing and collateral rights; funding is separately issuer-reported
Missing_Record: Signed counterpart; closing statement; competing offers; custody records
FOIA_or_Record_Target: Public filing follow-up; underlying agreement records if lawfully available

Exact_Claim: Issuer reports 220620679 pledged WLFI tokens at March 28 plus 157689435 during the next 13 weeks, totaling 378310114 at June 27
Evidence_Status: Established issuer disclosure; custody not independently verified
Counterevidence_or_Alternative: Collateral quantity is not cash or another draw; exact margin-call cause and lock-up mechanics unresolved
Recommended_Wording: The pledged token quantity increased while reported principal remained $15 million
Missing_Record: Custody ledger; margin notices; token-unit attribution; applicable lock-up releases
FOIA_or_Record_Target: Public filing follow-up; collateral-account records if lawfully available

Exact_Claim: The quarterly report describes WLF as a related party and says the Audit Committee reviewed and approved the token agreements and January loan under company policy
Evidence_Status: Established issuer statement about approval process
Supporting_Evidence: ALT5-S011 Note 1; ALT5-S010 section 23 market-check representations
Counterevidence_or_Alternative: No minutes, recusals or comparative pricing acquired; related-party status alone is not wrongdoing
Recommended_Wording: AI Financial reports Audit Committee approval; independent review of its decision process is not established
Missing_Record: Committee minutes; recusals; vote records; competing financing materials
FOIA_or_Record_Target: Public governance records; underlying board records if lawfully available

Exact_Claim: August 29 filing identifies Witkoff as chairman, Eric Trump and Folkman as observers, and Folkman's second WLF director seat as subject to stockholder approval
Supporting_Evidence: ALT5-S003 Item 5.02; compare ALT5-S001 initial announcement
Counterevidence_or_Alternative: Initial announcement is not proof of Eric Trump's implemented directorship; Morgan was described as a consultant
Recommended_Wording: Use the revised chairman, observer and conditional-seat descriptions when describing actual August roles
Missing_Record: Final appointment resolutions and role agreements
FOIA_or_Record_Target: Public filing follow-up

Exact_Claim: November Forms 3 identify Witkoff and Folkman as WLF representatives; February 27 shareholders elected both among seven directors
Source_Class: Issuer election filing and related-person Forms 3
Evidence_Status: Established filing assertions and reported election; exact Folkman start unresolved
Supporting_Evidence: ALT5-S005 Remarks; ALT5-S006 Remarks; ALT5-S008 Item 5.07; ALT5-S004 Proposal 2
Counterevidence_or_Alternative: Folkman Form 3 event date October 20 conflicts with February proxy August start; two seats do not prove majority control
Recommended_Wording: The records support actual WLF representation and the later election, while retaining the start-date discrepancy
Missing_Record: Appointment resolutions; reconciliation of inconsistent effective dates
FOIA_or_Record_Target: Public filing follow-up

Exact_Claim: Form SPA sections 4.20–4.21 contemplate treasury and investment governance rights, but reviewed later records do not establish every proposed committee or approval power was implemented
Source_Class: Form agreement, issuer proxy, quarterly report and governance pages
Evidence_Status: Documented proposed terms; implementation partly unresolved
Supporting_Evidence: ALT5-S002; ALT5-S003; ALT5-S007 Actions and Committees; ALT5-S011; ALT5-S013–014
Counterevidence_or_Alternative: Later proxy has three standing committees plus special/one-time committees; non-identification is not proof of nonexistence
Recommended_Wording: Distinguish implemented directors and reported policy from unverified implementation of form-SPA committee powers
Missing_Record: Committee charters and minutes; appointment and exercise records
FOIA_or_Record_Target: Public governance and filing follow-up

Exact_Claim: Quarterly report says ALT5 Digital provided $100 million of WLFI-token value under July 30 services terms and Concrete delivered a $3 million advance of expected returns
Evidence_Status: Established issuer disclosure; underlying MSA and SOWs not obtained
Counterevidence_or_Alternative: Token valuation is not cash; advance repayment shortfall is guaranteed; no cash/wallet reconciliation or personal recipient established
Recommended_Wording: Separate the reported token deposit value from the repayable advance; neither establishes personal income
Missing_Record: July MSA; two SOWs; settlement and release records
FOIA_or_Record_Target: Public counterparty and issuer disclosure follow-up

Exact_Claim: Issuer reports $25 million deployed by the quarterly filing toward a planned $32 million, without naming deployment recipients or a remunerated third party
Evidence_Status: Established issuer disclosure with unresolved downstream path
Counterevidence_or_Alternative: The 25m is within the 32m plan; relation to 3m advance unresolved; not a demonstrated ALT5 receipt or Russian-asset payment
Recommended_Wording: Concrete deployment progress and planned total are distinct observations and must not be added
Missing_Record: Deployment instructions; named recipient and third-party identity; bank/wallet attribution
FOIA_or_Record_Target: Public issuer and counterparty records if available

Exact_Claim: 2025 investor documents name World Liberty Financial, Inc.; the January loan names World Liberty Financial LLC as a Florida LLC; conversion or succession is unestablished in the reviewed set
Evidence_Status: Established named-party distinction; legal relationship unresolved
Counterevidence_or_Alternative: Shared branding and WLFI shorthand do not resolve legal identity; no registry conversion record acquired
Recommended_Wording: Keep the investor and lender names separate pending corporate continuity evidence
Missing_Record: Conversion, succession or affiliate registry records
FOIA_or_Record_Target: Public corporate registry records if available

Exact_Claim: Binance advertises WLFI and USD1 incentive pools with distinct accrual enrollment and conditional payout schedules; October20 notice clarifies account treatment.
Evidence_Status: Established advertised terms; payouts and funding allocation unverified
Counterevidence_or_Alternative: Eligibility restrictions are not verified enforcement; no personal receipt or governmental exchange established
Recommended_Wording: Documented commercial incentives extend the USD1 distribution relationship; promotional ceilings are not realized flows.
Missing_Record: Actual payouts; uptake; reward funding allocation; attributable recipient records
FOIA_or_Record_Target: Public issuer/exchange records and lawful transaction evidence
